messages:
Priya: Postmortem summary: transient control-plane errors from our cloud provider caused auth token exchange failures, which in turn caused ~20m of model-registry write errors and some degraded inference for queued requests. Need owners for fast mitigations + a longer-term resilience plan.
Ethan: Observed spike 02:472:59 UTC. Many clients retried aggressively which amplified the provider throttling. I volunteer to throttle our client-side retry loops and add full jitter. ETA: PR by Thu.
Marcos: I'll champion a registries fallback: on write failure threshold, switch reads to last-good snapshot and pause metadata flushes for 15m. Will prototype a config flag. ETA: Tue.
Priya: Good. Also: add an alert that fires if registry write success rate < 95% for 5m and include vendor incident link if available.
DevOps-bot: Created tasks: [INF-921] "Client retry jitter + limit" assigned to Ethan (due 2026-03-29). https://jira.redwood/INF-921
DevOps-bot: Created tasks: [REG-404] "Read-only fallback + pause flush" assigned to Marcos (due 2026-03-31). https://jira.redwood/REG-404
Ethan: I'll include a small smoke test that simulates provider 5xx and a local metric to surface retry amplification in Grafana.
Marcos: We should also start a weekly 'vendor-dep mini-retro' for 4 weeks to look for recurring patterns. Priya, can ops calendar that?
Priya: On it. Weekly 15m for the next 4 Mondays. Invite sent.
Ethan: Long-term suggestion: a provider-agnostic token adapter so swapping auth vendors for critical paths takes hours, not weeks. I'll draft a spec after the immediate fixes.
Priya: Action items for JIRA summary I'll post:
- Ethan: INF-921 retry limits & jitter PR by Thu
- Marcos: REG-404 fallback flag + runbook by Tue
- Priya: Alerts + weekly pulse calendar created
DevOps-bot: Note: INF-921 status -> in-progress (updated by Ethan)
Marcos: Quick snippet I'll add to REG-404 runbook for the fallback condition:
```
if write_errors >= 3 in 60s:
  switch_to_readonly_snapshot()
  pause_metadata_flush(900)
  notify(#incidents)
```
Ethan: Example smoke command I will add to CI:
```
python tools/simulate_provider_5xx.py --duration 30 --error-rate 0.5
```
Priya: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If anything spikes again, escalate immediately and ping me.
Ethan: :thumbsup:
DevOps-bot: Recurring event "vendor-dep mini-retro" scheduled every Mon for 4 weeks starting 2026-03-30."
